candidate_definitions.competing_interpretation: Keep the three accepted patterns standalone because their agencies and operative decisions differ materially and the shared disapproval mechanism may add too little explanatory value beyond the accepted pattern texts.

inputs.concise_input_summary: Opposition across two resolutions disapproving distinct EPA California vehicle-emissions waiver decisions.
Opposition across four resolutions disapproving distinct DOE appliance or commercial-equipment rules.
Opposition across seven resolutions disapproving distinct BLM land-management decisions.

material_limitations: The EPA, DOE, and BLM decisions concern different agencies, statutes, geographies, products, standards, plans, leases, withdrawals, and regulatory functions.
Consistent opposition to congressional disapproval does not establish unrestricted support for the underlying rules, standards, plans, leases, withdrawals, or agencies.
The candidate does not establish support for environmental regulation generally, climate policy generally, energy-efficiency mandates generally, or BLM policy generally.
Only the three accepted M12H repeated patterns are semantic inputs; contrast-only, no-safe, non-directional, and whole-package episodes remain outside synthesis.
prohibited_inferences: support for every EPA, DOE, or BLM decision
candidate_definitions.proposition: Across three independently accepted patterns covering 13 resolutions, Foushee repeatedly opposed congressional disapproval of distinct EPA California vehicle-emissions waiver decisions, Department of Energy appliance or equipment rules, and Bureau of Land Management land-management decisions.

relationship_basis.semantic_relationship: Three independently accepted repeated patterns share the bounded congressional-disapproval mechanism and the same accepted opposition direction while retaining distinct agencies, policy objects, and underlying decisions.

candidate_definitions.relationship_rationale: The candidate adds mechanism-level structure across three accepted pattern classes rather than regrouping raw environment or energy votes. Each pattern remains an independent semantic input, and the 13 underlying episodes are deduplicated lineage rather than additional proposition nodes.
candidate_definitions.unresolved_ambiguity: Human review must decide whether the common congressional-disapproval mechanism adds enough bounded explanatory information to justify synthesis across the three distinct pattern classes.
candidate_definitions.why_synthesis_not_topic_grouping: The relationship is the same congressional choice to oppose disapproval across three independently accepted pattern classes, not shared subject matter, agency identity, party, sponsor, or environmental-policy labeling.
